title: Sanitize and absolutize link hrefs before copying as a share URL
answers: Why would a shared span link be blank or unsafe?
How to safely turn a LinkModel href into a copyable share URL
Span share button copies wrong or dangerous URL
body:
Root cause risk: a LinkModel's href may be relative, missing, or (if derived from user/data-driven content) unsafe; copying it raw as a share link can produce an invalid or unsafe URL.
Fix pattern: build the share URL via new URL(href, window.location.href).href then textUtil.sanitizeUrl(...), and fall back to window.location.href whenever href is missing, sanitization returns '' or 'about:blank', or URL construction throws. See getShareUrl in public/app/features/explore/TraceView/components/TraceTimelineViewer/SpanDetail/ShareSpanButton.tsx.
Constraints: applies to any 'Share'/'Copy link' action that copies a link derived from a LinkModel or other data-sourced href, not to static same-origin links the app itself constructs.
applies: TraceView span detail share functionality and similar data-derived link-copy features
says: Shared link appears blank or navigates to wrong page
Copy link produces unsafe or malformed URL for sharing
Relative links fail when copied as shareable URLs
Missing link destination breaks copy-as-link feature
Share button copies unvalidated dangerous URL from response
search: Share URLs derived from link hrefs must be built by calling new URL(href, window.location.href).href then textUtil.sanitizeUrl(...), with fallback to window.location.href if the href is missing, sanitization returns '' or 'about:blank', or URL construction throws. This pattern prevents invalid or unsafe URLs from relative, missing, or data-driven hrefs being copied as share links. Applies to Share/Copy link actions on data-sourced hrefs like LinkModel entries in TraceView span details and similar data-driven link-copy features, not to static same-origin links the app constructs itself.
